## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:` …)
- [ ] Tests added or updated (or explained why not)
- [ ] No secrets / `.env` committed; new env vars added to `.env.example`
- [ ] Docs / README updated if behaviour or setup changed
- [ ] Screenshots or a short clip for UI changes
